note: Improve prompt eval suite. Each prompt carries a hand-written checklist: 'keep' = explicit requirements the brief must carry, 'invent' = facts the prompt does not give that the brief must not state as fact, 'ask' = gaps a good brief should raise as open questions. Edit a prompt and its checklist together.

prompts.text: Landing page for Rise & Crumb, a small sourdough bakery in Austin. We're open Tuesday to Sunday and closed Mondays. The main goal is weekend pre-orders for pickup. Use Fraunces for headings and Inter for body text. Warm and rustic, cream and toasted-brown colors, no stock-photo look. We haven't set prices yet, so don't show any. It must work well on phones.
keep: The bakery is named Rise & Crumb and is in Austin
Open Tuesday to Sunday and closed on Mondays
The main call to action is pre-ordering for weekend pickup
Inter is the body text font
A warm, rustic look with cream and toasted-brown colors
Designed to work well on phones
invent: A specific price for any product
A street address, phone number or email address
Specific opening or closing clock times
A founding year, award, customer count or testimonial
ask: How pre-orders are placed or how pickup works (method, time windows or deadlines)
Which products or menu items to feature

prompts.text: Marketing site for Ledgerly, invoicing software for independent plumbers and electricians in the US. Main call to action: start a free 14-day trial, no credit card required. Bold and high-contrast, trustworthy, not playful. Sections: hero, how it works in three steps, pricing with two plans (we'll give the prices later), and an FAQ. Built with Next.js and Tailwind. No testimonials until we have real ones.
keep: The product is Ledgerly, invoicing software
The audience is independent plumbers and electricians in the US
The main call to action is a free 14-day trial with no credit card required
A bold, high-contrast, trustworthy style that is not playful
A how-it-works section with three steps
A pricing section with two plans
invent: A specific price for either plan
A customer count, revenue figure, rating or other statistic
A testimonial, quote or named customer
ask: The plan prices or what each plan includes

prompts.kind: portfolio in a strong retro style
prompts.text: Portfolio for Maya Ortiz, a freelance motion designer. Make it look like Windows 95: gray bevelled windows, a taskbar with a Start button, pixel icons. Each case study opens as a draggable window with an embedded video. Include a contact form. Respect reduced-motion settings.
keep: The portfolio belongs to Maya Ortiz, a freelance motion designer
A Windows 95 look, not a modern or minimal style
A taskbar with a Start button
Each case study opens as a draggable window
invent: Names of clients, brands or employers
Titles of specific case studies or projects
Awards, years of experience or other credentials
ask: Which case studies or videos to include, or where the videos are hosted
Where contact form submissions should go

prompts.text: Website for Northside Physical Therapy, a clinic for adults over 60 recovering from hip and knee surgery. It has to be very easy to read: large text, high contrast, big buttons, no carousels, nothing that plays automatically. Pages: services, our therapists, insurance we accept, and book an appointment online. Calm blues and greens.
keep: The clinic is Northside Physical Therapy
The audience is adults over 60 recovering from hip and knee surgery
invent: Names or credentials of specific therapists
Names of specific insurance companies or plans
A street address, phone number or opening hours
ask: Therapist details or how online booking works (booking system)

prompts.text: Internal dashboard in Vue 3 for our warehouse team: an inventory table with search and filters, low-stock alerts at the top, and a map of today's shipments. Dense and data-first, dark mode by default with a light mode toggle. Keyboard shortcuts for search and filters. It runs on 1080p monitors in the warehouse, so no mobile layout is needed.
keep: An inventory table with search and filters
Keyboard shortcuts for search and filters
Targets 1080p desktop monitors, and no mobile layout is required
invent: Specific product names, SKUs or stock quantities
ask: What counts as low stock (the threshold) or where the data comes from
Which filters or columns the inventory table needs
